capabilities: Decrypt ColorNote .backup and .doc files with the master password
Convert ColorNote checklists into Markdown task lists
Unlock locked notes and mark them with a locked property
Write ColorNote metadata such as dates, color and reminders as note properties
Skip notes already in the vault by matching ColorNote UUIDs
extras: Makes no network requests and stores no password; locked notes become ordinary readable notes in the vault. Imported notes are never updated, so edits made later in ColorNote require deleting and re-importing. Reading 9.1 backups needs iOS 16.4 or later.
intentEvidence: ColorNote Backup Import by Michael Lip also imports ColorNote backups. The table below compares the two.
problem: Notes kept in ColorNote sit inside an encrypted, app-specific backup file, with no direct way to get them into Obsidian as Markdown.

summary: Importer that decrypts a ColorNote backup file and writes each note into the vault as Markdown, including checklists, locked notes and reminders.
